message: Assign each edge a score proportional to the inverse of its distance, normalized within each source city so shorter edges receive stronger preference while diagonal self-loops receive zero. import numpy as np def heuristics_v2(distance_matrix: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray: distances = np.asarray(distance_matrix, dtype=float) if distances.ndim != 2 or distances.shape[0] != distances.shape[1]: raise ValueError("distance_matrix must be a square 2D array") n = distances.shape[0] scores = np.zeros_like(distances, dtype=float) off_diagonal = ~np.eye(n, dtype=bool) safe_distances = np.maximum(distances, np.finfo(float).eps) scores[off_diagonal] = 1.0 / safe_distances[off_diagonal] row_max = scores.max(axis=1, keepdims=True) np.divide(scores, row_max, out=scores, where=row_max > 0) np.fill_diagonal(scores, 0.0) return scores
